source_artifacts.description: PROJECT_CANON.md, prior MASTER_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md, prior CHECKPOINT.md, etc.

mode.description: STANDARD: stepwise with checkpoints. AUTONOMOUS: executes architecture rounds without 'continue?' prompts, still checkpoints, still stops before deep research. UPDATE: extend/re-weight an existing program.

prior_run.description: Path to prior MASTER_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md / CHECKPOINT.md. Required when mode is UPDATE, or when resuming an interrupted AUTONOMOUS/STANDARD run.
